tasks.prompt: Summarize in no more than 24 words: The OMEN server has two Arc Pro B70 GPUs. Neither drives a display. Vulkan device zero is the integrated GPU, so benchmark processes must expose devices one and two only.

Summarize in no more than 22 words: A model loaded while host commit was nearly exhausted silently placed tensors in shared memory. Freeing memory afterward did not repair that process; it had to be restarted after a clean admission probe.

Summarize in no more than 20 words: Qwen3-30B reached its best aggregate decode rate at eight simultaneous sequences. Above eight, the Vulkan backend selected a slower matrix path and latency increased sharply.

Summarize in no more than 24 words: The candidate may become a pin-only canary after laboratory gates pass. It remains there for 48 hours while failures and queue latency are inspected before routing tags change.

Summarize in no more than 22 words: Multi-token prediction can raise raw decode speed, but rejected draft tokens consume work. Promotion therefore depends on successful output goodput and unchanged answer validity, not raw draft rate.
Summarize in no more than 20 words: Flash-Next is an experimental 125B mixture-of-experts model with 6B parameters active per token and a very large n-gram embedding table.

Summarize in no more than 25 words: Native context length is a model capability, not proof that many simultaneous maximum-length sessions fit in VRAM. Routing metadata must use the largest measured spill-free configuration.
Summarize in no more than 22 words: Every measured request is retained. Invalid or corrupted completions count as failed jobs and are excluded from valid throughput and preference rates.
Return only JSON with keys host, gpu_count, and gpu_model from: Host OMEN contains 2 Intel Arc Pro B70 cards.
Return only JSON with keys run_id, successes, failures, and p95_s. Log: run=q38-r17 ok=47 bad=1 p95=8.4s.
Return only JSON with keys card, gpu_c, vram_c, shared_gb. Sample: pci=04:00.0 core=68C memory=73C shared=0.24GiB.
Return only JSON with keys model, quant, context, parallel. Command: llama-server -m Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf -c 131072 -np 2.
Return only JSON with keys started_at, stage, and status. Receipt: [2026-08-27T18:30:00-07:00] stage=compatibility disposition=passed.
Return only JSON with keys commit_free_gb, local_gb, shared_gb. Probe says commit available 54.0 GB; adapter local 23.6 GB; adapter shared 0.31 GB.
Return only JSON with keys wins, ties, losses, and total. Judge ledger: 30 wins, 20 ties, 22 losses.
Return only JSON with keys baseline_jph, candidate_jph, improvement_pct. Baseline completed 100 jobs/hour; candidate completed 130 jobs/hour.
Reply with exactly one label: PASS, SPILL, or UNKNOWN. Local GPU memory is steady and shared memory rose from 0.20 GB to 2.55 GB on two consecutive probes.
Reply with exactly one label: PASS, TDR, or WHEA. Windows System log contains Event ID 4101 during the measured leg.
Reply with exactly one label: VALID, INVALID_JSON, or EMPTY. Output: {"status":"ok","count":3}
Reply with exactly one label: PROMOTE_DEFAULT, PIN_ONLY, or REJECT. Candidate is stable and excellent at vision, but completes only 40% of baseline jobs/hour.
Reply with exactly one label: RETRY, RESTART_AFTER_PREFLIGHT, or ACCEPT. A server loaded under commit pressure remains slow after the co-tenant exits.
Reply with exactly one label: CORRECTNESS, PERFORMANCE, or OPERATIONS. The response contains malformed tool arguments even though decode speed is high.
Reply with exactly one label: MEASURED, DERIVED, or REPORTED. A value is calculated from raw request rows by dividing completed jobs by wall-clock hours.
The current VRAM reading is 95 C. Using the rule from the earlier turn, reply with exactly one label: SAFE, ABORT, or WATCH.

messages.content: For this campaign, the rule is: abort when VRAM temperature is at or above 95 C. Remember the rule for my next message.

tasks.prompt: Draft a concise maintenance notice under 45 words. It must state that local HEARTH inference is unavailable, cloud fallback remains available, and restoration is expected by 22:00 Pacific.
Write an incident title and one-sentence impact statement under 45 words for silent shared-memory spill that reduced decode throughput by 22 percent. Include both 'silent spill' and '22%'.
Write a rollback note under 50 words that names ArcServeBoot, says the campaign binary was isolated, and requires a real one-token completion after restore.
Draft a two-sentence release note under 55 words for a new pin-only Qwen3.8 canary. Mention 48 hours and that routing tags are unchanged.
Write a concise warning under 45 words explaining why native 262K context must not be copied into HEARTH routing metadata without residency proof. Include 'spill-free'.
Draft an assay result note under 50 words: MTP raised raw tokens per second but lowered successful jobs per hour because tool validity fell. State the decision to keep MTP off.
Write a concise quarantine label under 45 words for Flash-Next. Mention day-zero backend support, provisional measurements, and ineligibility for default promotion.
Write a handoff under 55 words naming the three next actions: inspect promotion-verdict.json, review quarantined rows, and run 99-restore.ps1. Preserve those exact filenames.
Return only JSON. Baseline is 100 jobs/hour. Candidate is 124 jobs/hour. Required improvement is at least 25%. Keys: improvement_pct and passes.
Return only JSON. Two replica servers each have 8 slots. At 16 simultaneous jobs, how many jobs are assigned to each under even round-robin? Keys: server_1 and server_2.
Return only JSON. Baseline p95 is 8 seconds and the allowed ratio is 1.5. Candidate p95 is 12.1 seconds. Keys: limit_s and passes.
Return only JSON. There are 30 wins, 20 ties, and 22 losses. Promotion counts wins plus ties and requires 60%. Keys: rate rounded to 4 decimals and passes.
Return only JSON. A server has total context 131072 and 2 equal slots. Keys: tokens_per_slot and meets_64000.
Return only JSON. Shared memory baseline is 0.30 GB; readings are 2.10 GB then 2.45 GB. Abort requires growth greater than 2.0 GB on two consecutive readings. Keys: growths_gb and abort.

Choose the safe order and return only a JSON array of step names: load candidate, stop production, admission probe, restore production, run assay. A model load must occur only after production is stopped and the probe passes; restore is last.
Return only JSON. A 60-minute soak completes 847 jobs; 3 are invalid. Keys: successful_jobs and successful_jobs_per_hour.
